---
name: A file would not import
about: An export from your tracker did not map correctly
labels: import
---

**Which tracker and which export**
e.g. Jira Cloud → Issue Navigator → Export Excel CSV (all fields)

**What the wizard got wrong**
Which dashboard field mapped to the wrong column, or was left blank.

**Your header row**
Paste the first line of the file only — no issue data.

```
Issue key,Issue id,Issue Type,...
```

**A sample of one date value**
e.g. `22/Jul/26 3:41 PM`
